scoped_dependencies.relation: The finite-message secrecy bound imports the N659 source-reported physical-decoder transfer theorem; blockwise environment dominance is separately required.

failure: Failure: No arbitrary adaptive wiring, automatic environment-versus-receiver order from a scalar self-coefficient, newly established capacity mechanism, or claim of a new asymptotic strong converse. Novelty of the finite-k refinement remains UNKNOWN.
interface: Interface: Uniform k-message code, k>=2, receiver average error epsilon and delta=one-half trace distance from product of the uniform message and environment marginal. Environment dominates receiver in measured chi-square for the block channel actually used.

claims.title: A finite-message SLD bound couples decoding reliability to trace-distance secrecy
